claims.statement: QIK-VRT revision -03 defines exactly five version-1 outcomes and permits ordinary release only for a valid EFFECT_ACK_DONE.
claims.boundary: Active individual experimental Internet-Draft; not an RFC or IETF consensus.

claims.statement: The revision -03 CoreDone predicate contains 17 conjunctive conditions, with additional consumer authentication, freshness, schema and chain checks.
claims.boundary: A record digest does not establish the truth of external evidence.

claims.statement: RFC 9110 is a June 2022 Standards Track RFC for HTTP Semantics, not an expired Internet-Draft.
claims.boundary: RFC 9110 does not specify QIK-VRT EFFECT_ACK.

claims.statement: The finite C90 evidence enumerates 2,621,440 valid snapshots, 5,242,880 consumer-admission variants and 7,864,387 checks.
claims.boundary: Enumeration count is test scope, not operations per second.

claims.statement: The finite evidence contains 1,310,719 assignments with transport acknowledgement but without DONE.
claims.boundary: This supports separation of transport receipt and effect authorization only within the enumerated model.

claims.statement: For N canonically ordered mesh nodes, the issue-agent epoch identifies a lane by row * N + column and admits at most N squared lanes.
claims.boundary: Quadratic coverage is also quadratic work; it is not an automatic speedup.

claims.statement: A simple periodic scan performs N times f checks per second for N items polled at frequency f.
claims.boundary: Actual CPU, latency and energy savings require a measured workload.

claims.statement: The exact typed-executor repair candidate has remote head e91c20940c090a1b830556d1e5cbfed9e05773e5 and tree a54342c7c3bb38ec745e0bd243c48a39c1e35c97.
claims.boundary: Not merged and not Authority-main at article freeze.

claims.statement: The typed executor accepts only an exact registered handler-id and handler-digest pair; unmapped work holds.
claims.boundary: The one registered executor produces only a bounded control-plane attestation, not arbitrary issue completion.

claims.statement: The inspected PR #914 worktree contained 3,967 tracked files and approximately 400.7 million bytes.
claims.boundary: Repository size is not a performance measure and does not describe a deployable minimum.

claims.statement: The compiled M68000 registry contains five kernels totaling 284 machine bytes.
claims.boundary: The registry explicitly records physical execution and physical speedup as unobserved.

claims.statement: The 24-byte M68000 gate projection executes at most six M68000 instructions for its four semantic input classes.
claims.boundary: This narrow projection is not a complete EFFECT_ACK receipt or AI workload.

claims.statement: The repository contains four QIK-VRT VHDL files with a testbench; CI analyses, elaborates and simulates them with GHDL.
claims.boundary: The workflow declares synthesis NOT_CLAIMED; no FPGA, ASIC, bitstream or board result follows.

claims.statement: The H6 bundle includes 15 codec theorems within a 55-theorem receipt and 39 EBNF obligations.
claims.boundary: No compression ratio, throughput or independent external reproduction is inferred.

claims.statement: The real-mesh implementation targets four local processes, two Authority/Mirror pairs and bounded multi-hop loopback routes.
claims.boundary: No general Internet deployment or unbounded mesh operation is claimed.

claims.statement: The HTTP terminal reference is a bounded two-phase local demonstrator with Firefox reference integration.
claims.boundary: It is not a complete Firefox rebuild, universal daemon or IETF standard implementation.

claims.statement: NVIDIA specifies 144 cores and 500 W CPU-plus-memory power for the Grace CPU Superchip; the current configuration table couples 960 GB with up to 768 GB/s and 240/480 GB configurations with up to 1,024 GB/s.
claims.boundary: These are SKU-specific platform specifications, not QIK-VRT benchmark results; NVIDIA documentation also contains a 228 MB versus 234 MB L3 discrepancy.

claims.statement: AMD specifies 192 cores, 384 MB L3, 614 GB/s memory bandwidth and 500 W default TDP for EPYC 9965.
claims.boundary: TDP is not measured wall energy for a QIK-VRT workload.

claims.statement: AMD specifies 288 GB HBM3E, 8 TB/s bandwidth and 1,400 W typical board power for MI355X.
claims.boundary: GPU specifications are not directly comparable to CPU application throughput.

claims.statement: MLPerf v6.0 reports approximately 95,004 offline and 82,136 server token/s for the cited 8x MI355X gpt-oss-120b result, 103,961 offline and 100,328 server token/s for NVIDIA DGX B300, and 1,042,980 offline and 1,072,250 server token/s for NVIDIA GB300 NVL72.
claims.boundary: The comparison is valid only within the same model, scenario and quality rules; the entries do not measure power.

claims.statement: Receipt/s cannot be divided by token/s to establish an AI speedup.
claims.boundary: A token-generation workload and a policy/evidence-bound effect decision perform different work.

claims.statement: No public end-to-end QIK-VRT performance, energy or cost baseline is currently populated.
claims.boundary: No general percentage, multiplier or joule saving is claimed.

claims.statement: QIK-VRT has a structural modelling connection to delayed-choice, conditional classification and observer-relative ordering.
claims.boundary: This is not empirical confirmation of QIK-VRT and not controllable backward signalling.

claims.statement: A Lean kernel result establishes a theorem relative to its definitions, imports, axioms and toolchain, not the empirical truth of model premises.
claims.boundary: Physical correspondence requires calibrated measurement and independent empirical validation.

claims.statement: Patentability of QIK-VRT or any subcombination has not been established.
claims.boundary: Novelty, inventive step, technical effect, enablement and jurisdiction-specific exclusions require professional examination.

claims.statement: Future revenue or resource savings are possible product hypotheses but are not guaranteed.
claims.boundary: Requires measured customer value, productization, sales, legal costs and market adoption.

claims.statement: Ingolf Lohmann reports approximately eighteen months of unusually intensive work under substantial physical and mental strain and persistent scepticism.
claims.source: Product Owner statements in the originating conversation
claims.boundary: Attributed personal history; not independently medically or historically verified by this bundle.

claims.statement: The non-polling quadratic VHDL candidate reobserved for PR #912 has head 244970c8c7f29b15eb8df48c28c80c96719ea118 and tree 6578ffacb3b30faed68ff3fe9b86bfb04eead350.
claims.boundary: The candidate is not asserted to be Authority-main, merged, deployed or physically synthesized.

claims.statement: The protected serial quadratic codec frame has N squared times W plus 72 wire bits; at 12 MHz with W=8 its approximate no-stall rates are 115,385 frames/s for N=2, 20,548 for N=8 and 365 for N=64.
claims.boundary: Only N=2 is configured in the candidate board top; these are serial-link arithmetic bounds, not board measurements or complete receipts per second.

claims.statement: The PR #912 codec and admission RTL do not implement the complete five-state Effect-Acknowledgement wire, authority, SHA-256, evidence, ledger and persistence semantics.
claims.boundary: Synthesis, place-and-route, bitstream, programming, board observation, PASS, FINAL_PASS and EFFECT_ACK_DONE remain false.

claims.statement: NVIDIA lists DGX Spark with a 20-core Arm CPU, 128 GB unified LPDDR5X, 273 GB/s, up to 1 PFLOP FP4 with sparsity, a 240 W power supply and a US marketplace price of USD 4,699 on 2026-08-29.
claims.boundary: Vendor specifications and a dated listed price do not establish QIK-VRT performance, energy savings or future pricing.

claims.statement: Amdahl's law bounds end-to-end speedup to 1/((1-p)+p/s) when only fraction p is accelerated by factor s.
claims.boundary: The relevant pipeline fraction and accelerator factor must be measured under identical semantics.

claims.statement: If a deterministic prefilter avoids fraction r of otherwise linearly scaling LLM requests, the idealized capacity multiplier is 1/(1-r), before accounting for gate and system overhead.
claims.boundary: The 1.11x, 2x and 10x examples for r=10%, 50% and 90% are sensitivities, not QIK-VRT benchmark results.

claims.statement: A physical correspondence claim requires the full path from calibrated empirical input through canonical representation and formal processing to real execution and independent empirical reobservation.
claims.boundary: Hash identity, Lean proof and RTL simulation do not individually substitute for calibrated physical measurement and independent replication.

claims.statement: Ingolf Lohmann asserts that QIK-VRT and the bound Zenodo formalizations correspond to real physical relations.
claims.source: Product Owner statements in the originating conversation
claims.boundary: The attributed assertion is distinct from independent empirical confirmation and scientific consensus.

claims.statement: Effect Acknowledgement is an application-level semantic envelope that can be profiled over HTTP, DNS references, SMTP, SNMP, QUIC or overlay transport without creating a new OSI or IP layer.
claims.boundary: The repository currently demonstrates bounded HTTP/Firefox and TCP loopback only, not production conformance for all named services.

claims.statement: For payload P, existing headers H, receipt R and evidence references E, relative byte overhead is (R+E)/(P+H).
claims.boundary: The 1 KiB overhead examples are illustrative; actual encoding, batching and reference sizes must be measured.

claims.statement: The candidate publication index contains 14 Zenodo records and eleven candidate states including this quantitative article.
claims.boundary: One observer-relative-retrocausality bundle is still projected as a candidate despite an indexed published Zenodo record and needs state reconciliation, not duplicate publication.

claims.statement: Public disclosure before filing can destroy patent novelty, and the DPMA states that an inventor's own public information can form prior art.
claims.boundary: Jurisdiction-specific exceptions require professional legal advice; this matrix does not determine patentability.

claims.statement: Universal autonomous software development for precisely specified Turing-computable tasks is the Product Owner's architecture target, while the current evidence is a bounded typed executor and not a proof of correct synthesis from arbitrary informal requirements.
claims.source: Product Owner audio instruction and PR #914 typed-executor contract
claims.boundary: Incomplete, inconsistent or informal requirements do not become complete specifications through automation alone.

claims.statement: If a system hypothetically draws the full 240 W power-supply nameplate continuously and a later measurement establishes a linear 10% wall-energy reduction, the arithmetic sensitivity is 210.24 kWh per year before utilization, cooling and load-curve corrections.
claims.boundary: The 240 W figure is a power-supply rating, not a measured QIK-VRT workload draw; this is not a measured saving or a guaranteed electricity cost reduction.
